natural: three or five years, a few years

meaning.en: A few years; an indefinite span of several years.
meaning.zh: 三五年，泛指几年的时间。

examples.zh: 学好一门外语不是三年五载的事。
examples.en: Mastering a foreign language is not a matter of a few years.

examples.zh: 这棵树要三年五载才能结果。
examples.en: This tree will take some years to bear fruit.

examples.zh: 他离家三年五载，家乡变化很大。
examples.en: He left home for several years, and his hometown changed a great deal.

usage.en: Note the pronunciation 载 zǎi (year), not zài. Often used with 不是 / 才能 to stress that something takes a long time. A word group rather than a classical idiom.
usage.zh: 注意“载”读 zǎi，意为“年”。常与“不是”“才能”连用，强调需要较长时间。

natural: snow in midsummer, a sign of a great injustice

meaning.en: Snow falling in the sixth month; a heaven-sent sign that someone has suffered a terrible wrong.
meaning.zh: 六月天下起雪来，比喻有天大的冤案，感动上天。

examples.zh: 这桩冤案简直是六月飞雪，让人愤愤不平。
examples.en: This miscarriage of justice is like snow in midsummer; it makes everyone furious.

examples.zh: 老师给我们讲了窦娥冤里六月飞雪的故事。
examples.en: Our teacher told us the story of snow falling in June in the play Dou E Was Wronged.

examples.zh: 他蒙冤入狱多年，真是六月飞雪的冤情。
examples.en: He was jailed for years for a crime he did not commit, a case worthy of midsummer snow.

story.en: In Guan Hanqing's play, the wrongly condemned Dou E vows that snow will fall in the sixth month to prove her innocence, and it does.
story.zh: 元代关汉卿的杂剧《窦娥冤》写窦娥含冤被斩，临刑发誓六月飞雪，果然应验。

usage.en: Refers to the story of Dou E, a young widow wrongly executed. As she died, snow fell in midsummer. Used for serious injustice only, never for a mere unusual weather event. Literary.
usage.zh: 出自窦娥冤的故事，只用来形容重大冤情，不是单纯说天气反常。

natural: never tire of reading it again and again

meaning.en: Of a book or piece of writing: so good that you can read it a hundred times without getting bored.
meaning.zh: 书或文章写得好，读多少遍也不厌烦。

equivalents: a book you never tire of

examples.zh: 这本童话我百读不厌。
examples.en: I never get tired of this fairy tale.

examples.zh: 好的诗歌往往百读不厌。
examples.en: Good poems can usually be read again and again.

examples.zh: 他推荐了几本百读不厌的小说。
examples.en: He recommended some novels you can re-read endlessly.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive. Praises writing, not people. Often follows 这本书、这首诗 and the like. Said of books, poems and essays.
usage.zh: 作谓语、定语，称赞书籍、诗文，不用于人。

natural: out of all other choices, nothing could be done

meaning.en: Utterly helpless, with no other choice open.
meaning.zh: 毫无办法，实在没有别的选择。

examples.zh: 万般无奈之下，他只好卖掉了老房子。
examples.en: With no other choice, he had to sell the old house.

examples.zh: 妈妈万般无奈，只好答应了我。
examples.en: Mum had no way out and had to give in to me.

examples.zh: 公司在万般无奈的情况下宣布裁员。
examples.en: The company announced layoffs as a last resort.

usage.en: Usually adverbial: 万般无奈之下 / 万般无奈地. Describes being forced into an unwelcome decision. A word group; more emphatic than 无奈.
usage.zh: 多作状语，常说“万般无奈之下”，比“无奈”语气更重。

literal: ten thousand · matters · smooth · go through

meaning.en: Everything goes smoothly and succeeds; a stock good wish.
meaning.zh: 各种事情都很顺利，没有阻碍。

examples.zh: 新年到了，祝你万事亨通！
examples.en: Happy New Year; may everything go well for you!

examples.zh: 他刚开业，朋友们都祝他万事亨通。
examples.en: His friends wished him smooth sailing as he opened his business.

examples.zh: 她希望新的一年万事亨通，身体健康。
examples.en: She hopes the new year brings success in everything and good health.

usage.en: Mainly a greeting or blessing, often written on cards and gifts. Formal and slightly old-fashioned; near 万事如意 but stresses smooth progress rather than satisfaction.
usage.zh: 多用作祝福语，书面、稍显传统；与“万事如意”相近，但更强调顺利通达。

meaning.en: A girl of about sixteen, in the bloom of youth; a young beauty.
meaning.zh: 指十六岁左右的美丽少女。

examples.zh: 画中的二八佳人，眉目如画。
examples.en: The girl of sixteen in the painting is a perfect picture.

examples.zh: 京剧里常有二八佳人的角色。
examples.en: Peking opera often features a young beauty as a role.

examples.zh: 她不是二八佳人，却依然气质出众。
examples.en: She is no sixteen-year-old beauty, but her bearing is still remarkable.

usage.en: The numbers 二八 are two times eight, i.e. sixteen. Literary, used in fiction, opera and poetry; sounds old-fashioned in modern speech.
usage.zh: “二八”即十六岁；多见于小说、戏曲、诗词，现代口语较少用。

natural: a three-foot-tall child, any small child

meaning.en: A small child; used to say that even a young child knows something.
meaning.zh: 指身高才三尺的小孩子，泛指年幼的孩子。

examples.zh: 这个道理三尺童子都懂。
examples.en: Even a small child understands this principle.

examples.zh: 骗人的把戏，连三尺童子都骗不了。
examples.en: Such a trick would not fool even a little child.

examples.zh: 你这样的做法，三尺童子也知道不对。
examples.en: Even a toddler would know that is wrong.

usage.en: Usually used to say something is so obvious that even a child knows it: 三尺童子也知道. Literary; 三尺 refers to a child’s height in the old measure.
usage.zh: 常用“连三尺童子都知道”表示道理浅显。带书面色彩。

natural: the Three Sovereigns and Five Emperors

meaning.en: The legendary rulers of remote Chinese antiquity, before recorded history.
meaning.zh: 传说中中国上古时代的帝王，泛指远古的圣明君主。

examples.zh: 历史课上，老师讲到了三皇五帝的传说。
examples.en: In history class the teacher told legends about the Three Sovereigns and Five Emperors.

examples.zh: 他对三皇五帝以来的历史很有研究。
examples.en: He has studied history since the age of the sage-kings.

examples.zh: 这件事自三皇五帝以来都没有过。
examples.en: Nothing like this has happened since the dawn of Chinese history.

usage.en: Who counts as the Three Sovereigns and Five Emperors varies by source (e.g. Fuxi, Shennong, Huangdi; Yao, Shun and others). Used for remote antiquity, or ironically for "since forever".
usage.zh: 三皇五帝的具体人选各书说法不一，常泛指远古；也可用来夸张地表示“自古以来”。

meaning.en: Peace and calm throughout the whole country.

examples.zh: 盛世之时，四海升平，百姓安居乐业。
examples.en: In a golden age there is peace everywhere and people live in contentment.

examples.zh: 人们都盼望四海升平。
examples.en: Everyone longs for peace throughout the land.

examples.zh: 春联上写着“四海升平”。
examples.en: The Spring Festival couplet reads: peace throughout the land.

usage.en: Formal and often used in blessings, couplets and historical writing. 四海 means the whole country. Also written 四海昇平.
usage.zh: 书面语，常见于祝词、对联和史书。“四海”指天下。也作“四海昇平”。

meaning.en: Facing enemies or opposition from every direction.
meaning.zh: 四面八方都有敌人，处境十分被动危险。

examples.zh: 这座城池四面受敌，很难守住。
examples.en: The city was attacked from every side and hard to hold.

examples.zh: 新产品刚上市就四面受敌，竞争对手纷纷降价。
examples.en: The new product was under attack from all sides as rivals cut prices.

examples.zh: 球队后防线四面受敌，一直在苦苦支撑。
examples.en: The team's defence was under pressure from all directions and just held on.

usage.en: Predicate. Used both literally in war and figuratively in business and sport. Compare 腹背受敌 (attacked front and back).
usage.zh: 作谓语，可用于战争，也可比喻商业、体育中的困境。与“腹背受敌”相近。

natural: all kinds of trades and crafts

meaning.en: All sorts of trades and occupations.
meaning.zh: 泛指各行各业，三百六十行。

examples.zh: 这条老街上五行八作应有尽有。
examples.en: The old street has every kind of trade.

examples.zh: 他走南闯北，五行八作的人都认识。
examples.en: He has travelled widely and knows people from every trade.

examples.zh: 来赶集的人五行八作，什么人都有。
examples.en: People from all walks of life come to the fair.

usage.en: Note 行 is read háng here (trade). Colloquial and old-fashioned, often used for the variety of people met in a market or a town.
usage.zh: “行”读 háng，指行业；口语，略带旧时色彩，多指市集、城镇里各色人等。

meaning.en: Unable to sing in tune, tone-deaf.
meaning.zh: 唱歌走调，不会辨别和唱出准确的音调。

examples.zh: 我五音不全，所以不敢在同学面前唱歌。
examples.en: I can't carry a tune, so I dare not sing in front of my classmates.

examples.zh: 他五音不全，却特别爱唱卡拉OK。
examples.en: He is tone-deaf but loves karaoke.

examples.zh: 她笑着说自己五音不全，不如听别人唱。
examples.en: She laughed and said she was tone-deaf and preferred to listen.

usage.en: Usually a modest or humorous remark about oneself. 五音 are the five notes of the old Chinese scale (宫商角徵羽). Often paired with 四体不勤 jokes; the usual contrast is 能歌善舞.
usage.zh: 多用于自嘲或开玩笑。“五音”指宫商角徵羽五个音阶。

natural: the Six Secret Teachings and Three Strategies

meaning.en: Two ancient Chinese works on military strategy; by extension, the art of war or superior planning.
meaning.zh: 《六韬》《三略》两部古代兵书，泛指兵书，也比喻用兵的谋略。

examples.zh: 将军熟读六韬三略，善于用兵。
examples.en: The general knew the classic military texts well and was skilled in warfare.

examples.zh: 他读了不少六韬三略之类的兵书。
examples.en: He read a lot of strategy books such as the Six Secret Teachings.

examples.zh: 这个经理满腹六韬三略，总能想出办法。
examples.en: This manager has a head full of strategy and always finds a way.

usage.en: Note 略 is read lüè. 《六韬》 is traditionally credited to Jiang Ziya and 《三略》 to Huang Shigong. Literary; can be used humorously about business tactics.
usage.zh: “略”读 lüè。《六韬》旧传为姜太公所作，《三略》旧传为黄石公所作。书面语。

meaning.en: A rare chance that comes only once in a thousand years.
meaning.zh: 一千年才有这一次，形容机会极其难得。

examples.zh: 这次比赛是千载一时的好机会，大家要珍惜。
examples.en: This competition is a once-in-a-lifetime chance, so make the most of it.

examples.zh: 千载一时，不容错过。
examples.en: A chance in a thousand years must not be missed.

examples.zh: 奥运会在家乡举办，真是千载一时的盛事。
examples.en: Hosting the Olympics in our hometown is a rare great occasion.

usage.en: Note 载 here is zǎi (year). Similar to 千载难逢 but more literary and less common. Used as attributive or predicate.
usage.zh: “载”读 zǎi。与“千载难逢”相近，但更书面、较少用。

meaning.zh: 形容时间极其久远，永远流传。

examples.zh: 这首民歌万古千秋，传唱至今。
examples.en: This folk song has been sung through the ages and still is today.

examples.zh: 长城将万古千秋屹立在大地上。
examples.en: The Great Wall will stand for all time.

examples.zh: 他们的友谊万古千秋。
examples.en: Their friendship will last for ever.

usage.en: Literary and rhetorical; often used in praise, memorials and inscriptions. Can be predicate or adverbial.
usage.zh: 书面色彩浓，多用于颂扬、纪念和题词，可作谓语、状语。

natural: ten thousand men cannot force it open

meaning.en: Of a pass or position so secure that even ten thousand men cannot break through.
meaning.zh: 形容地势险要，一个人把守，万人也攻不破。

equivalents: a fortress that cannot be forced

examples.zh: 剑门关易守难攻，一夫当关，万夫莫开。
examples.en: Jianmen Pass is easy to defend and hard to attack: one man guards it and ten thousand cannot break in.

examples.zh: 这里山势险峻，真有万夫莫开之势。
examples.en: The mountains here are so steep that it would be impregnable.

examples.zh: 这座山口万夫莫开。
examples.en: No army could force this mountain pass.

story.en: Li Bai describes the Sichuan road: 'One man holds the pass, ten thousand cannot break through' (一夫当关，万夫莫开).
story.zh: 李白《蜀道难》：“剑阁峥嵘而崔嵬，一夫当关，万夫莫开。”

usage.en: Nearly always quoted with the first half: 一夫当关，万夫莫开. Describes strong natural defences. Literary.
usage.zh: 几乎总与上句“一夫当关”连用，形容地势险要易守难攻。

meaning.en: A vast expanse of blue-green water or fields stretching as far as the eye can see.
meaning.zh: 一片青绿，辽阔无边，形容湖海或田野广阔。

equivalents: as far as the eye can see

examples.zh: 站在湖边，只见一碧万顷，心情豁然开朗。
examples.en: Standing by the lake, I saw the boundless blue-green and my mood lifted.

examples.zh: 夏天的草原一碧万顷。
examples.en: In summer the grassland spreads green as far as the eye can see.

examples.zh: 海面一碧万顷，海鸥在天空飞翔。
examples.en: The sea was a vast blue-green and gulls flew across the sky.

story.en: Fan Zhongyan describes Dongting Lake: 'a vast sweep of blue-green' (一碧万顷) in spring brightness.
story.zh: 范仲淹《岳阳楼记》：“至若春和景明，波澜不惊，上下天光，一碧万顷。”

usage.en: A set phrase for scenery, often in school compositions. 顷 is a land measure (about 6.7 hectares), so 万顷 means vast. Mostly water, sometimes fields.
usage.zh: 常用于景物描写，学生作文常见。“顷”是面积单位，“万顷”形容极其辽阔。

natural: one rider leaves the dust behind

meaning.en: To race far ahead of everyone else; far outstripping the competition.
meaning.zh: 一个人骑马飞奔，尘土都追不上，比喻遥遥领先，远超他人。

examples.zh: 比赛一开始，他就一骑绝尘，没人追得上。
examples.en: From the start he raced ahead and nobody could catch him.

examples.zh: 这款手机销量一骑绝尘。
examples.en: The phone's sales left its rivals in the dust.

examples.zh: 这家公司在行业中一骑绝尘。
examples.en: This company is far ahead of the rest of its industry.

usage.en: Originally a picture of a galloping horse. Now used in news and sport for a clear leader. Can be predicate or adverbial. Positive.
usage.zh: 原指骑马飞驰，现多用于体育、商业报道，形容遥遥领先。
